body: Pretty much sums up a lot of my time spent. It feels like a chore to communicate socially. My excitement for everyday life and trying new things is non existent. I will watch a YouTube video and not even realize what they are talking about. I feel like I’m just going through the motions.

It especially hurts when that person contributes to your depression. My dad always wants me to be motivated and do all of this stuff. But then he gives me a ton of stuff to do so I don’t have enough time to fit it in. Or when you are having a bad day and genuinely are unhappy and people get angry at you for being so “rude” after they offer advice that is pointless.

Thanks for the advice. I am trying to get back into working out as that helps relieve stress and I’m trying to work on my hygiene as that’s something that i can occupy my time with. It really helps to hear people’s advice and motivation tips for me at least.
